name: Web: List the open page's links
summary: List the same-site pages the open page links to, as rzn.items/v2 listing entries.
description: List the links of the page the owner has open that stay on its site, each once, as listing entries keyed web:page:<normalized URL>. No navigation, scrolling or request. The listing tool of the web family; web/page reads one entry.

url.description: The page's URL. The page is read where it is open; the URL names it in the run record.

steps.name: List the open page's same-site links as rzn.items/v2

output_schema.description: rzn.items/v2 (schema/rzn.items.v2.json): same-site page entries, listing feed.

help.summary: List the same-site pages the open page links to, as rzn.items/v2 listing entries.
returns: rzn.items/v2, listing feed (a page shows some links, never all), up to 500 entries: key web:page:<link>, url the normalized link, kind page, title the link text.
notes: Read-only, in place: one script over the loaded document, no request of its own.
